identificationModule.briefTitle: SHR-A1811 for Subjects With Her2-positive Gastric Cancer and Gastroesophageal Junction Adenocarcinoma After Progression on or After First-line Anti-HER2 Therapy-containing Regimen
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 3, Multicenter, Randomized, Open-label Study of SHR-A1811 (HER2-ADC) Compared With the Chemotherapy Treatment Chosen by the Investigators for Subjects With HER2-positive Metastatic and/or Unresectable Gastric Cancer or Gastroesophageal Junction Adenocarcinoma Who Have Progressed on or After First-line Anti-HER2 Therapy-containing Regimen

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study will assess the efficacy and safety of SHR-A1811 compared with treatment chosen by the investigator in participants with HER2-positive (defined as immunohistochemistry \[IHC\] 3+ or IHC 2+/in situ hybridization \[ISH\]+) gastric or GEJ adenocarcinoma (based on \[American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) College of American Pathologists (CAP) guidelines who have progressed on or after a first-line anti-HER2 therapy-containing regimen.

conditions: HER2-positive Advanced Gastric Cancer or Gastroesophageal Junction Adenocarcinoma

interventions.name: SHR-A1811
interventions.description: SHR-A1811 6.4 mg/kg IV infusion every 3 weeks on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle

primaryOutcomes.description: defined as the time from date of randomization until death from any cause.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Time from date of randomization until death (due to any cause), up to approximately 42 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: defined as the time from date of randomization until first objective radiographic tumor progression or death from any cause, based on Investigator assessment.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Time from date of randomization until first objective radiographic disease progression or death (due to any cause) whichever occurs first, up to approximately 42 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: defined as the proportion of participants who achieve a best response of complete response (CR) or partial response (PR) using the Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors version 1.1 (RECIST v1.1) criteria as assessed by Investigator.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From start of treatment to date of documented disease progression, up to approximately 42 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: defined time from the initial response (CR or PR) until documented tumor progression or death from any cause and based on Investigator assessment.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Time from initial response (CR or PR) to date of documented disease progression or death (due to any cause) whichever occurs first, up to approximately 42 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: defined as the proportion of participants who achieved CR, PR, or stable disease (SD) for a minimum of 6 weeks during study treatment, based on Investigator assessment.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From start of treatment to date of documented disease progression, up to approximately 42 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: Adverse events will be graded according to the National Cancer Institute-Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events Version 5.0.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From time subjects signs informed consent form up to 40 days after last study dose

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Immunogenicity indicators of SHR-A1811: including anti-SHR-A1811 antibodies (ADA and neutralizing antibodies)
Serum concentrations of SHR-A1811 toxin-binding antibodies and free toxin SHR169265
